title: Step 4 · combine layers (Figure 3)
code:
df1 <- pivot_longer(data = df,
        cols = c("New York", "San Francisco"),
        names_to = "City", values_to = "Temperature")
df2 <- mutate(df, Diff = `New York` - `San Francisco`)
ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = df2, aes(xmin = Date - 2, xmax = Date + 2,
            ymin = `San Francisco`, ymax = `New York`, fill = Diff)) +
  geom_step(data = df1, aes(x = Date, y = Temperature, color = City)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3d74b8", mid = "#f2f2f2", high = "#b8433a") +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Temperature", fill = "Temp Diff")

title: Falx's export, run in R
code:
# Table program synthesized by Falx, written as tidyverse
# Falx keeps dates as text, as in its input table
d <- mutate(rename(df, date = Date), date = as.character(date))
data_0 <- pivot_longer(d, cols = c(`New York`, `San Francisco`),
                       names_to = "KEY", values_to = "VALUE")
data_1 <- mutate(d, COL_0 = `New York` - `San Francisco`)
data_0$row_id <- as.numeric(row.names(data_0))
data_1$row_id <- as.numeric(row.names(data_1))
# ggplot2 line exported by Falx, verbatim
p <- ggplot() + geom_line(data=data_0,aes(x=`date`,y=`VALUE`,col=`KEY`,group=`KEY`),alpha=0.5) + geom_rect(data=data_1,aes(x=`date`,ymin=`San Francisco`,ymax=`New York`,fill=`COL_0`,xmin=`row_id`-0.45,xmax=`row_id`+0.45),stat ='identity',alpha=0.5) + scale_x_discrete()
p
